assumptions.statement: Site and key-area polygons are provisional constraints inferred from public descriptions.
assumptions.impact: All spatial quantities must be recalculated when official polygons are released.

assumptions.statement: Regulatory controls, road redlines, ownership, municipal utilities, heritage buffers and engineering constraints are unavailable.
assumptions.impact: No FAR, height, demolition, road alignment or utility claim is treated as approved.

assumptions.statement: Nine service-station footprints and operating roles are conceptual.
assumptions.impact: Locations, operators, accessibility and safety require co-design and professional survey.

assumptions.statement: AI services use data minimization, visible purposes and human fallback as design requirements.
assumptions.impact: A data-protection impact assessment and operating rules are prerequisites for any pilot.

assumptions.statement: Phasing describes reversible tests rather than funded construction commitments.
assumptions.impact: Each phase requires owner, funding, consent, engineering and statutory review.
